provenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Original portrait environment matte for a high-end native Android 3D music player. This is scenery only, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: An immaculate natural dawn lake environment inspired by the supplied reference's quiet blue-gray mist, layered forested hills, and subtle freshwater reflections.
Scene/backdrop: A calm still freshwater lake, distant soft layers of forested mountains, small wisps of mist over the water. Near the bottom edge: understated damp gray stones, a little moss, restrained natural ferns at lower corners. The center of the lake is empty and unobstructed.
Style/medium: Photorealistic AAA environment render, physically plausible natural materials, refined cinematic art direction, restrained detail and realistic scale.
Composition/framing: Portrait 1024 by 1536 pixels. Horizontally level lake horizon approximately 40 percent from the top. Upper 35 percent is clean pale blue-gray open sky with a few delicate diffuse clouds. Mountain silhouettes occupy the distant horizontal band. A large calm readable empty water area fills the middle and lower-middle. Shore detail is confined to bottom 12 percent and the extreme bottom corners. Eye-level viewpoint from lake shore, straight camera without perspective exaggeration.
Lighting/mood: Gentle overcast early dawn, no visible sun, cool pearl-blue daylight with a subtle neutral warm dawn tone near the horizon. Soft atmospheric depth and smooth natural reflections. Bright and breathable enough for deep charcoal text to remain legible.
Color palette: Pale pearl blue, cool slate blue, muted stone gray, restrained natural green. Medium-light luminance overall.
Materials/textures: Physically believable lake reflections, tiny low-amplitude ripples, wet stone microtexture, softly lit moss and fern fronds.
Constraints: No geode, no central rock, no floating objects, no controls, no interfaces, no text, no logo, no watermark, no particles, no surreal architecture. Do not darken with a vignette. This asset will sit behind separately rendered true 3D geode and glass lenses; leave the water area quiet and uncluttered. Do not imitate the black UI from the screenshots.

provenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Original landscape environment matte for the same native 3D dawn-lake world as the supplied portrait reference. Generate a newly composed matching landscape scene; do not resize, crop, stretch or merely extend the portrait.
Primary request: A calm blue-gray natural lake at dawn, immaculate photorealistic AAA environment render, matching the portrait's exact cool pearl-blue light, misty wooded hills, restrained muted green vegetation, pale pink-neutral dawn horizon, and realistic shallow fresh water.
Input images: Image 1 is the already generated portrait environment, used for lighting, color palette and natural materials only; Image 2 is a frame of the user's video, used for atmosphere and quiet environmental depth only.
Scene/backdrop: A still natural freshwater lake bordered by soft layers of forested mountain hills and low wisps of dawn mist. Near the bottom edge are understated damp gray stones, a little moss and restrained ferns at the lower corners. The center and wide middle remain empty and unobstructed.
Style/medium: Refined photorealistic environment render with physically plausible lighting, natural scale and coherent perspective. Real stone and fern textures.
Composition/framing: Landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels. Level horizon about 40 percent from the top. Upper 35 percent is clean pale blue-gray sky with sparse diffuse dawn clouds. Layered forested mountains form a distant horizontal band. Wide calm water fills the middle and lower-middle. Shore detail stays inside the bottom 12 percent and extreme lower corners. Eye-level viewpoint from lake shore, straight level camera, no fisheye, no dramatic wide-angle distortion.
Lighting/mood: Quiet soft early dawn, gentle diffuse cool daylight, no visible sun, no dramatic directional shafts. Bright breathable medium-light luminance without becoming washed out.
Color palette: Match the supplied portrait: pale pearl blue, muted slate blue, neutral gray stone, restrained natural green and a tiny neutral dawn warmth near the horizon.
Materials/textures: Soft small freshwater ripples, natural reflected mist and forests, believable wet stones, natural moss and fern fronds.
Constraints: This asset is scenery only. No geode, no central rock, no floating object, no interface, no control, no icon, no text, no logo, no particles, no light filaments, no watermark, no dark vignette, no surreal architecture. Do not bake any interaction state into it. Keep empty readable space across the lake for separately rendered real 3D geode and navigation lenses.
